name: API Key
description: Enter your Mail Chimp API Key below.

name: Email List Number
description: Enter the list number for the email list which should be used for the email list synch.  The default Mail Chimp list number is '1'.

name: Error Report Email Address
description: Enter the an email address which should receive messages concerning problems with accounting system integrations.  Typically these errors messages are sent when problems occur during interaction with accounting systems.

name: Default Payment Method: Alternate System
description: Enter the default payment method name, to be used for unmapped payment methods, for the accounting system using the Alternate Accounting System Data Slot.

name: Default Payment Method: Primary System
description: Enter the default payment method name, to be used for unmapped payment methods, for the accounting system using the Primary Accounting System Data Slot.

name: Default Shipping Method: Alternate System
description: Enter the default shipping method name, to be used for unmapped shipping methods, for the accounting system using the Alternate Accounting System Data Slot.

name: Default Shipping Method: Primary System
description: Enter the default shipping method name, to be used for unmapped shipping methods, for the accounting system using the Primary Accounting System Data Slot.

name: Default Tax Vendor
description: Select the vendor to be assigned to tax items created for accounting system integrations.  If you require tax items to use different vendors, after tax items are exported to your accounting system, adjust vendors in the accounting system directly for applicable items.

name: Management Fee Percentage
description: Enter the default management fee percentage used by some accounting integrations for intercompany sales.

name: Activate Ajax Mini Cart
description: Select true to activate an ajax mini cart, or false to deactivate it.

name: Activate Ajax Product Search
description: Select true to activate an ajax product search, or false to deactivate it.

name: iDevAffiliate Script URL
description: If Affiliate Order Reporting is set to iDevAffiliate, enter the URL for an iDevAffiliate sale.php script to enable posting order information to iDevAffiliate software.

name: Affiliate Order Reporting
description: Select an option to enable order affiliate order reporting.  You can use an iDevAffiliate URL, or your own custom script.

name: Allow Gift Certificate Use on Gift Certificate Purchases
description: Select true (1) to allow gift certificates to be used to purchase gift certificates.  Select false (0) to disable the ability to purchase gift certificates with gift certificates.  Set to false (0) if you ever sell gift certificates at a discounted rate.

name: Allow Guest Checkout
description: Select true to allow checkout for guest users.  If checkout for guest users is allowed, an account will not be required to checkout.

name: Combine Inventory Item Offers
description: Select true (1) to combine like Inventory Items in the Shopping Cart when added separately.

name: Display Images
description: Select true to display images in the shopping cart.  Images will be displayed if at least one item has a valid image and this setting is true.

name: Display Free Shipping Prompt
description: Select true (1) to display a free shipping prompt on the shopping cart page alerting the customer to free shipping information.  Available only when free shipping is available for the customer.

name: Free Shipping Prompt Disclaimer
description: Enter optional additional text to be displayed in the Free Shipping Prompt on the shopping cart page.  Free shipping exlcusions and limitations should be noted here.

name: Shopping Cart Promo Active
description: Select true (1) to enable the display of the cart promo image, or false (0) to suppress it

name: Shopping Cart Promo Image
description: This is the image presented under the shopping cart on the shopping cart page for promo purposes.  Upload an image and set Shopping Cart Promo Active to true to activate.

name: Shopping Cart Promo Link (Full URL)
description: Enter a full URL which will be used as a link for the Shopping Cart Promo Image.  If no URL is entered, no link will be printed with the Shopping Cart Promo Image.  Example: https://yourdomain.com/Page

name: Use Quantity Selection Drop Downs
description: Select true (1) to use quantity selection drop downs for quantities less than 10 in the cart and wish list.  A text input option is automatically displayed for selections of 10+.

name: Display Compare Savings
description: Select true (1) to display comparison savings in the shopping cart when pricing is discounted (wholesale, special offer pricing, sale pricing, etc).

name: Product List: Heading Name
description: If there are upsell products to display, the name below is used to present a heading.

name: Product List: Activate Slider
description: If there are upsell products to display, choose true (1) to activate a slider control for those products, or false (0) to suppress the slider.

name: Use Quantity of One for Inventory Item AddOns
description: Select true (1) to use a quantity of one for Inventory Item AddOns that are added to the shopping cart.  Select false (0) to use the quantity entered for the offer.  This setting does not affect AddOns using Multiple Quantity Input displays.

name: Category List: Display Description
description: Select true to display category descriptions, when enabled for each category, in standard view.  Consider displaying additional links for categories when displaying descriptions.

name: Category Header: Display Type
description: Select the type for the category header when displayed in category feature grid view.  You can select description only, image and descripiton, or to disable the display.

name: Category Section Headers: Display Type
description: Select the type for the category section headers in category feature grid view.  You can select description only, image and descripiton, or to disable the display.

name: Product Offers: Display Add Button(s)
description: Select true to display add to cart, add to wish list and/or view options buttons in category feature grids.

name: Category List: Display Additional Link
description: Select true to display an additional link for the category, when enabled for each category, in standard view.  This setting is useful to highlight links when descriptions are also shown.

name: Category List: Display per Row
description: This setting controls how many categories are displayed horizontally per row in wide (desktop) display mode when displayed in standard view.

name: Category Header: Display Type
description: Select the type for the category header when displayed in standard view.  You can select description only, image and descripiton, or to disable the display.

name: Checkout Disabled Message
description: Enter a message in this field to Disable Checkout.  If a message is present in this field, checkout will be disabled, and this message will be displayed.

name: Enable Checkout Ajax Updates
description: Select true to enable ajax updates for the checkout section.

name: Checkout Header Message
value: Please check your items and select your preferred delivery option and your chosen payment method below.
description: Enter text to be displayed at the top of checkout in a bold message.

name: Combo Promotion Active
description: Select true (1) to activate the combo promotion, which will activate Special Offers and the Loyalty Points Multiplier, depending on their settings.

name: Combo Promotion Limits: Cookie Value
description: When the combo promotion is active, and limited to customers with a special cookie, this is the value used for the cookie issued to the customer.

name: Combo Promotion Limitations
description: When the combo promotion is active, you can select to limit the promotion to customers.  Select the limitations you would like to put into place for the combo promotion.  Selecting no limitations will activate the combo promotion for all shoppers.

name: Combo Promotion Limits: User Groups
description: When the combo promotion is active, and limited to certain user groups, this listing controls which groups are allowed access.

name: Product Offer List Full Add to Cart Status
description: Select true (1) to display full add to cart forms for product offer list displays.

name: Custom Package Description
value: Custom Packages allow you to build your own custom bundle of items at discounted pricing.

name: Custom Package Display Name
description: This display name is used for all references to package deals.

name: Discount Exclusion Status
description: This setting allows you to control Discount Exclusions status for the store.  If this value is set to false (0), discount exclusions will be inactive, regarless of discount exclusion selections for Product Offers.

value: Denotes exclusion from all discount offers.  Discount codes are not applicable on excluded items.
description: This description is used when displaying information about Discount Exclusions.

name: Discount Exclusion Force Display
description: Set to true (1) to force discount exclusion displays and icons for Product Offers, and to display them for categories, when selected, regardless of whether discount exlcusions are active.  Set to false (0) to only show displays and icons when discount exclusions are actually active.

name: Discount Exclusion Icon Display
description: Set to true (1) to automatically display discount exclusion icons for Product Offers, and to display them for categories, when selected.  Set to false (0) to suppress all discount exclusion icons.

name: Local Warehouse Address
description: Enter the address where the local warehouse is located.  This entry is used for all ecommerce shipping quotes which are not dropshipped.

name: Local Warehouse City
description: Enter the city where the local warehouse is located.  This entry is used for all ecommerce shipping quotes which are not dropshipped.

name: Local Warehouse Country
description: Select the country where the local warehouse is located.  This entry is used for all ecommerce shipping quotes which are not dropshipped.

name: Local Warehouse Telephone Number
description: Enter the local telephone number for the local warehouse.

name: Local Warehouse State/Province
description: Select the state/province where the local warehouse is located.  This entry is used for all ecommerce shipping quotes which are not dropshipped.

name: Local Warehouse Zip/Postal Code
description: Enter the zip/postal code where the local warehouse is located.  This entry is used for all ecommerce shipping quotes which are not dropshipped.

name: Low Inventory Alert Level
description: Enter the inventory level at which to trigger a low inventory alert.  Zero is a valid value which will trigger an alert when inventory runs out.

name: Low Inventory Alert Status
description: Select true (1) to turn low inventory alerts on.  When on, if an inventory item is ordered which has an inventory level at or below the Low Inventory Alert Level, an email will be sent to the site owner indicating inventory is low.  Select false (0) to turn this feature off.

name: Activate Loyalty Points System
description: Select true to activate the loyalty points system.  If this system is activated, be sure to add loyalty point values to products and priced product option selection items.

name: Loyalty Points Earned on Account Creation
description: Enter the number of loyalty points which should be awarded to users creating new accounts.  Loyalty points are awared in whole numbers, so do not enter a decimal value.  Please note: New accounts will not be awared loyalty points if a value of zero, or less than zero, is entered.

name: Loyalty Points Multiplier
description: Enter a multiplier for loyalty points.  This multiplier is used to multiply the number of points paid for purchases.  Entering any value greater than one (1) activates points multiplication.

name: Loyalty Points System Name
description: Enter a name for the loyalty points system.  This name is used througout the software to reference the loyalty points system.

name: Loyalty Points Earned for Orders
description: Enter the number of loyalty points which should be awarded to users who place an order.  Loyalty points are awarded in whole numbers, so do not enter a decimal value.  Please note: Accounts placing orders will not be awarded loyalty points if a value of zero, or less than zero, is entered.

name: Loyalty Point Value
description: Enter a currency amount in the system base currency representing how much each loyalty point is worth.  Please note: A value of zero, or less than zero, will deactivate the system.

name: Manufacturer Sale Active
description: Select true (1) to activate manufacturer sales.  If active, sales any manufacturer sales which have been configured for each manufacturer will be activated.

name: Manufacturer Sale Name
description: Enter a name for the manufacturer sale.  The manufacturer name is prepended to this sale name when displayed.

name: Banner Advertisement Group
description: Enter a banner advertisement group name if you would like to display banner advertisements at the top of the Manufacturers page. Leave blank to suppress banner advertisements. If a group name is entered, a banner advertisement placed in the content section must have this group name in order to display a banner advertisement.

name: Category Menu Display Status
description: Select true (1) to display Manufacturers in the store category menu, or false (0) not show a menu item for Manufacturers.

name: Manufacturers Display Name
description: This display name is used to reference Manufacturers.

name: Manufacturer Header: Display Type
description: Select the type for the category header when displayed on manufacturer pages.  You can select description only, image and descripiton, or to disable the display.

name: Maximum Combined Package Weight
description: Enter a maximum combined package weight below.  If a shipment is requested which contains items that can be combined with other items for shipping, this maximum combined package weight limits the size of the combined packages.  This weight should be entered in pounds (LB) or kilograms (KG) depending on the global weight setting.

name: Minimum Order Amount
description: Enter a minimum order amount below.  If you enter an amount greater than zero, users attempting to checkout with a total of items in their shopping cart less than the amount specified will be presented with a message indicating they need to add more items to their cart to checkout.  Set to '0.00' to turn off.

name: Enable Stock Notifications
description: Select true to enable stock notifications for inventory items.  If stock notifications are enabled, users can sign up to receive a notification when an item which is out of stock is made available.

name: Enable Stock Notification Request Alerts
description: Select true to enable stock notification request alerts for inventory items.  If stock notifications are enabled, a notification can be sent when customers request in stock notifications.

name: Offer Pricing Display: Hide EU/UK VAT Info
description: Select true (1) to hide EU/UK VAT information on offer prices displayed in product listings, and on product detail pages.  Select false (0), the default, to display EU/UK VAT information.  This control is only applicable when EU/UK VAT is active.

name: Order Confirmation: Banner Advertisement Group
description: Enter a banner advertisement group name if you would like to display banner advertisements at the top of the order confirmation page. Leave blank to suppress banner advertisements. If a group name is entered, a main banner advertisement must have this group name in order to display a banner advertisement.

name: Customer Order Mail Message Promo Active
description: Select true (1) to enable the display of a promo image in customer order mail messages, or false (0) to suppress it.

name: Customer Order Mail Message Promo Image
description: This is the image presented in customer order mail messages for promo purposes.  Upload an image and set Customer Order Mail Message Promo Active to true to activate.

name: Customer Order Mail Message Promo Link (Full URL)
description: Enter a full URL which will be used as a link for the Customer Order Mail Message Promo Image.  If no URL is entered, no link will be printed with the Customer Order Mail Message Promo Image.  Example: https://yourdomain.com/Page

name: Activate Payment Terms Conversion
description: Select true (1) to activate payment terms conversion for orders.  If active, when unpaid orders with payment terms are completed, if the selected payment term has a positive number of days entered for terms conversion, terms will be converted to a due date.  The due date is calculated by adding the number of days entered for the payment term to the order completion date.  Select false (0) to disable payment terms conversion.

name: Download Files: Number of Accesses Allowed
description: Enter the number of accesses to allow for download files in orders.  Download files are downloaded from the order summary page.

name: Order Mail Message Gift Certificate Notice
value: Your order contains a gift certificate!  Scroll down to see your gift certificate code.
description: Enter an optional message to include at the top of order mail messages containing gift certificate codes.   This message is intended to draw attention to the codes contained in the mail message.

name: Guest Order Invoice Display Option
description: Select true (1) to display a printable order invoice link instead of a printable order summary link for completed guest orders.  Select false (0) to always display a printable order summary link.

name: Guest Order Invoice Mail Option
description: Select the conditions under which guest orders will receive an order invoice mail message, instead of an order complete mail message, when the order is completed.  This option is only valid when Send Order Completed Mail Messages is set to true (1).

name: Suppress Logo on Internal Order Mail Messages
description: Select true (1) to suppress the logo image on internal and shipping mail messages sent by the Order Manager.  Select false (0) to include logo images in these mail messages.

name: Display Margins on Internal Order Mail Messages and Summaries
description: Select true (1) to display margins on wholesale orders, when available, for internal order mail messages and order summaries.

name: Add Review Conditions to Internal Order Comments
description: Select true (1) to add review conditions to internal order comments, or false (0) to not add review conditions to internal order comments.

name: Order Review Email Domains
description: Enter a single, or comma-delimited list, of domain names, when matched to the email address used for the order, will cause an order to be marked for review.

name: Order Review Conditions
value: SERVICED, UNPAID, BILLSHIPNOMATCH, SHIPMETHODMATCH, OOSITEMS, DROPSHIPITEMS
description: Select conditions which will mark an order for review.

name: Order Review Item Check: Price
description: Enter a single item price for review item checks to trigger a check (along with a quantity) for items ordered, at or above, a set price/quantity level.

name: Order Review Item Check: Quantity
description: Enter a quantity for review item checks to trigger a check (along with the price) for items ordered at, or above, a set price/quantity level.

name: Order Review Shipping Methods
description: Enter a single, or comma-delimited list, of partial shipping method names which, when matched, will cause an order to be marked for review.  As this listing is of partial names used for matches, entering a partial method name like 'Freight' will match on all orders containing any shipping method that contains the string 'Freight'.

name: Send Order Completed Mail Messages
description: Select true (1) to send order complete mail messages to customers when orders are completed, or false (0) to suppress sending these mail messages.

name: Send Order Shipped Mail Messages
description: Select true (1) to send order shipped mail messages to customers when orders are shipped, or false (0) to suppress sending these mail messages.

name: Increase Delivery Total: Delivery Memo Prefill
description: Enter a Delivery Memo to be prefilled for use in the Increase Delivery Total function.

name: Display Payment Address on Unpaid Customer Order Mail Messages
description: Select true (1) to display the payment address on unpaid customer order mail messages, or false (0) to suppress the payment address.

name: Order Number Prefix
description: If you select a prefixed Order Number Type, enter an order number prefix here.  This prefix will be appended to all order numbers.

name: Order Number Type
description: Select the type of order number generated by this software for orders.

name: Display Compare Savings
description: Select true (1) to display comparison savings on orders when pricing is discounted (wholesale, special offer pricing, sale pricing, etc).

name: Package Deal Description
value: Package Deals offer great pricing on a bundle of items.
description: This description is used when displaying information about Package Deals.

name: Package Deal Display Name
description: This display name is used for all references to Package Deals.

name: Allow Users to Manage Payment Tokens
description: Select true (1) to allow users to manage the storage of payment tokens for their account.   Payment tokens are stored only for processing gateways which utilize them.  Selecting false (0) will disable the save token choice in checkout, and will remove the ability to delete tokens from the account section.

name: Instant Payment Notification (IPN) Activated Status
description: In order to properly validate PayPal Standard transactions, IPN must be activated at PayPal.  You can activate IPN on PayPal by accessing Account Settings / Website Payments / Instant Payment Notifications and choosing to turn on IPN and entering an IPN URL (use a URL similar to https://domain.com/utilities/ecomrelay.php).  If MultiSite is active, the IPN URL will be dynamically changed.

name: Payment Data Transfer Token
description: Enter your PayPal Payment Data Transfer Token.  You can obtain a token from PayPal by accessing Account Settings / Website Payments / Website Preferences and choosing to turn on auto return (use a URL similar to https://domain.com/utilities/ecomrelay.php), and choosing to turn on payment data transfer.  A token will be provided.

name: API URL
description: This is the API URL used by this software to connect to the PayPal Website Payments Pro SOAP server.

name: Currency Code
description: Enter the three letter currency code of the currency you wish to use for PayPal Website Payments Pro payments.  This currency code should be the same as the the currency you've used to enter your products in the Catalog Manager.  Examples: USD, GBP, CAD, JPY, etc.

name: PayPal Express Checkout Email
description: If an API username, password and their associated keyfile contents are not entered, this email address is used with this software's API username to faciliate PayPal Website Payments Pro Express Checkout.

name: Enable PayPal Express Checkout Link
description: Select true to activate the PayPal Website Payments Pro Express Checkout Link.  PayPal requires the use of the Express method if you also choose to use the Direct method.

name: Keyfile Contents (API Keyfile)
value:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
...
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
description: The contents of the API key file you downloaded from PayPal (cert_key_pem.txt) need to be entered into the field below.  This key file should be associated with the API Password you enter on this page.  You can use an API Keyfile instead of an API Signature.

name: API Login: User Password
description: Enter your PayPal Website Payments Pro API password that you selected for your API username.

name: API Login: Signature
description: Enter your PayPal Website Payments Pro API signature.  You can use an API Signature instead of an API Keyfile.

name: API Login: User Name
description: Enter your PayPal Website Payments Pro API username that was provided to you by PayPal.

name: Points Multiplier Limits: Cookie Value
description: When the points multiplier has a value greater than one (1), and limited to customers with a special cookie, this is the value used for the cookie issued to the customer.

name: Points Multiplier Heading
value: Congratulations!  You've Qualified for Double Loyalty Points on everything you purchase today!  The loyalty points you see displayed on our site have already been doubled.
description: When the points multiplier has a value greater than one (1), and active for the customer, this heading can be displayed in the online store to alert the customer.

name: Points Multiplier Limitations
description: When the points multiplier has a value greater than one (1), you can select to limit point multiplication to customers.  Select the limitations you would like to put into place for the points multiplier.  Selecting no limitations will multiply points for all shoppers.

name: Points Multiplier Limits: User Groups
description: When the points multiplier has a value greater than one (1), and limited to certain user groups, this listing controls which groups are allowed access.

name: Realtime: Present Dimensional Error Notices
description: If the dimensions of a shipment are above the maximum dimensions allowed by a realtime carrier and an error is produced as a result, in addition to using the Shipping Error Carrier Name and Amount for the rate, a notice can be presented by this software.  Select true below to present this notice, or false to suppress it.

name: Realtime: Present Weight Error Notices
description: If the weight of a shipment is above the maximum weight allowed by a realtime carrier and an error is produced as a result, in addition to using the Shipping Error Carrier Name and Amount for the rate, a notice can be presented by this software.  Select true below to present this notice, or false to suppress it.

name: Product Listing: Display per Page
description: Select how many products should be displayed per page by default in standard view product listings.

name: Slot 5 Filter: Activate

name: Slot 5: Sort Order

name: Slot 1: Sort Order
description: Enter a sort order for the product filter in slot 1.  This sort order should be numeric and will be used to control the order in which this filter is displayed.

name: Price Filter: Activate
description: Select true to activate the price product filter.  This filter works based on the sort price entered for products.  Note that the product filter must be activated for this setting to take effect.

name: Price Filter: Sort Order
description: Enter a sort order for the price product filter.  This sort order should be numeric and will be used to control the order in which this filter is displayed.

name: Slot 3 Filter: Activate
description: Select true to activate the product filter in slot 3.  This filter works based on the slot 3 filters selected for products.  Note that the product filter must be activated for this setting to take effect.

description: Enter a sort order for the product filter in slot 2.  This sort order should be numeric and will be used to control the order in which this filter is displayed.

description: Select true to display the product short description in standard view product listings.

name: Product Listing: Display Add Button(s)
description: Select true to display add to cart, add to wish list and/or view options buttons in standard view product listings.

name: Product Listing: Display per Row
description: This setting controls how many products are displayed horizontally per row in wide (desktop) display mode for standard view product listings.

name: Use PopUp/Modal Functionality For Images
description: Select true to display popup/model functionality for extra large product images, or false to suppress it.

name: Use Zoom Functionality For Images
description: Select true to display zoom functionality for large product images, or false to suppress it.  When zoom functionality is activated, zoom functionality is automatically enabled.

name: Enable Ajax Price Auto Updates
description: Select true to enable ajax price auto updates on the product detail page, or false to disable them.

name: Display Facebook Like Button
description: Select true to display a Facebook like button on product detail pages, or false to suppress the button.

name: Display Google Plus Button
description: Select true to display a Google plus button on product detail pages, or false to suppress the button.

name: Display LinkedIn Share Button
description: Select true to display a LinkedIn share button on product detail pages, or false to suppress the button.

name: Display Pinterest PinIt Button
description: Select true to display a Pinterest pinit button on product detail pages, or false to suppress the button.

name: Display Twitter Tweet Button
description: Select true to display a Twitter tweet button on product detail pages, or false to suppress the button.

name: Free Gift Certificate Promo Status
description: Select true to activate the Free Gift Certificate promo.  When active, gift certificates are generated for orders based on the total spent.

name: Free Gift Certificate Order Total Breakpoint
description: Enter a positive amount to use as an order total breakpoint to determine if a Free Gift Certificate should be delivered with an order.

name: Shopping Cart Descriptive Text
description: This description is used to provide more information in the Free Gift Certificate promotion area on the shopping cart page.

name: Free Gift Certificate Expiration
description: Enter an end date, or a number of days until expiration from the order date, for gift certificates issued under the Free Gift Certificate promotion.  If a date is entered, it must be entered in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format.  If a number of days is entered, enter a positive number, 1 (for one day) or greater.  Enter zero (0) to not set an expiration date.

name: Free Gift Certificate Multiplier Limit
description: If Free Gift Certificate Multiplier Status is set to true (1), enter a multiplier limit to limit the maximum Gift Certificate Value and Order Total Breakpoint.  Enter zero (0) to use no limit.

name: Free Gift Certificate Multiplier Status
description: Select true (1) to allow multiplication of the Gift Certificate Value by the number of times the Order Total Breakpoint is seen in the Order Total.

name: Free Gift Certificate Promo Name
description: Enter a name for the Free Gift Certificate promotion.

name: Free Gift Certificate Product Offer ID
description: Enter the identifier of a product offer which is set up as a service with the Auto-Generate Gift Certificate field set to true (1).  The product offer you specify will be used to create the gift certificate for this promotion.

name: Free Gift Certificate Value
description: This is the Gift Certificate value. Enter a currency amount using the base currency for this component. Do not include a currency symbol - enter only an amount (example: 10.00).

name: Free Gift Certificate Start
description: Enter a start date for gift certificates issued under the Free Gift Certificate promotion.  If a date is entered, it must be entered in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format.  If a number of days is entered, enter 0 (for the order date), or greater.

name: Free Product Offer Promo Status
description: Select true to activate the Free Product Offer promo.  When active, free Product Offers are added to the shopping cart based on the total spent.

name: Level 1: Minimum Order Total
description: Level 1: Minimum shopping cart total, or '0.00' to deactivate level.

name: Level 2: Minimum Order Total
description: Level 2: Minimum shopping cart total, or '0.00' to deactivate level.

name: Level 3: Minimum Order Total
description: Level 3: Minimum shopping cart total, or '0.00' to deactivate level.

name: Level 4: Minimum Order Total
description: Level 4: Minimum shopping cart total, or '0.00' to deactivate level.

name: Level 5: Minimum Order Total
description: Level 5: Minimum shopping cart total, or '0.00' to deactivate level.

name: Level 6: Minimum Order Total
description: Level 6: Minimum shopping cart total, or '0.00' to deactivate level.

name: Level 7: Minimum Order Total
description: Level 7: Minimum shopping cart total, or '0.00' to deactivate level.

name: Free Product Offer Promo Name
description: Enter a name for the Free Product Offer promotion.

name: Level 1: Product Offer ID
description: Level 1: Enter the identifier of the product offer to add to shopping carts when this level is met.

name: Level 2: Product Offer ID
description: Level 2: Enter the identifier of the product offer to add to shopping carts when this level is met.

name: Level 3: Product Offer ID
description: Level 3: Enter the identifier of the product offer to add to shopping carts when this level is met.

name: Level 4: Product Offer ID
description: Level 4: Enter the id of the product you want to add to cart if this level is met.

name: Level 5: Product Offer ID
description: Level 5: Enter the identifier of the product offer to add to shopping carts when this level is met.

name: Level 6: Product Offer ID
description: Level 6: Enter the identifier of the product offer to add to shopping carts when this level is met.

name: Level 7: Product Offer ID
description: Level 7: Enter the identifier of the product offer to add to shopping carts when this level is met.

name: Offer Gift Certificate Promo Status
description: Select true to activate the Offer Gift Certificate promo.  When active, gift certificates are generated for offers which have an Offer Gift Certificate Promo Value.

name: Offer Gift Certificate Expiration
description: Enter an end date, or a number of days until expiration from the order date, for gift certificates issued under the Offer Gift Certificate promotion.  If a date is entered, it must be entered in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format.  If a number of days is entered, enter a positive number, 1 (for one day) or greater.  Enter zero (0) to not set an expiration date.

name: Offer Gift Certificate Limit
description: Enter limit to limit the maximum Gift Certificate Value and for the Offer Gift Certificate promotion.  Enter zero (0) to use no limit.

name: Offer Gift Certificate Promo Name
description: Enter a name for the Offer Gift Certificate promotion.

name: Offer Gift Certificate Product Offer ID
description: Enter the identifier of a product offer which is set up as a service with the Auto-Generate Gift Certificate field set to true (1).  The product offer you specify will be used to create the gift certificate for this promotion.

name: Offer Gift Certificate Start
description: Enter a start date for gift certificates issued under the Offer Gift Certificate promotion.  If a date is entered, it must be entered in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format.  If a number of days is entered, enter 0 (for the order date), or greater.

name: Purchase Order Number: Auto-Shorten
description: Select true (1) to auto-shorten purchase order numbers.  This setting is typically activated if you're using a prefixed purchase order number type and the purchase order numbers generated are too long for the systems some vendors use.  Auto-shortening decreases date-formatted years to two digics, eliminates the 'PO' prefix, and reduces all other prefixes to one character.  Example: A shortened version of POXXX201701011 is X1701011.

name: Purchase Order Number Type
description: Select the type of purchase order number generated by this software for purchase orders.  Prefixed types are automatically prepended with 'PO'.

name: Low Inventory Report: Inventory Level Trigger
description: Enter an inventory level at which to trigger reporting in the Low Inventory report displayed in the Purchase Order Center.  Enter zero (0) to disable this report.

name: Dropship Purchase Orders: Use Source Order Delivery Method
description: Select true (1) to use the delivery method for the source order for dropship purchase orders.  This setting is typically activated if you've arranged with vendors to dropship packages via the delivery method requested in purchase orders.  Typically vendors will ship either standard or express speeds.

name: Suppress Logo on Mail Messages
description: Select true (1) to suppress the logo image on mail messages sent by the Purchase Order Manager.  Select false (0) to include logo images in these mail messages.

name: Memo Prefill: Dropship Purchase Orders
description: Enter a memo to be prefilled for Dropshipped purchase orders.

name: Memo Prefill: Standard Purchase Orders
description: Enter a memo to be prefilled for Standard purchase orders.

name: Default MultiSite Selection
description: If MultiSite is active, you can select the default MultiSite selection for new purchase orders.

name: Quantity Rules Enforcement Status
description: Select true to enforce Quantity Rules for Inventory Items.  Inventory Items can have Purchase Minimum Quantity, Purchase Incremental Quantity and Purchase Maximum Quantity values set.  Select true (1) to use Quantity Rules Enforcement for Inventory Items, or false (0) to disable this feature.

name: Instant Rebate Status
description: Select true (1) to activate instant rebates.  Instant rebates are added to Product Offers and Inventory Items using Catalog pricing.  Rebates are instant discounts subtracted from the order total at checkout.

name: Instant Rebate Description
value: Add items with Instant Rebates to your cart to see the rebate, which will be applied at checkout.
description: This description is used when displaying information about Instant Rebates.

name: Instant Rebate Display Name
description: This display name is used for all references to Instant Rebates.

name: Display Related Products
description: Select true to display related products on the product detail page, or false to not display related products.

name: Product List: Heading Name
value: You may also be interested in these related items...
description: If there are related products to display, the name below is used to present a heading.

name: Product List: Activate Slider
description: If there are related products to display, choose true (1) to activate a slider control for those products, or false (0) to suppress the slider.

name: Number of Current Reviews to Display
description: Select the number of current reviews to show when displaying reviews.

name: Require Account to Post Review
description: Select whether to require an account in order to post reviews (true), or to allow guests to post reviews (false) as well.

name: Require Activation for Reviews
description: Select whether to require an administrator to manually activate reviews to make them display (true), or to display reviews immediately when they are submitted (false).

name: Activate Slider For Reviews Display
description: If there are reviews to display, choose true (1) to activate a slider control for those reviews, or false (0) to suppress the slider.

name: Activate Reviews
description: This status indicator allows you to turn reviews on (true) or off (false).

name: Custom Sale Method
description: If you have selected to activate the Custom Sale Method Status, select the custom sale method to execute during checkout below.

name: Disable Filter: Search Results
description: If product filters are enabled, and filters are available for products displayed on the search results page, a product filter will be displayed.  Set this value to true to disable display of product filters on the search results page.

name: Minimum Customer Input Price
description: Enter a minimum price to allow for customer price input on service items.  Services which allow customer inputted prices will require an input of at least this amount.

name: Allowed Shipping Addresses
description: This software can allow a customer to ship their order to multiple addresses, a single address or to their billing address only.  Select the appropriate option to control the type and number of addresses allowed for shipping.

name: Shipping Times: Ship Days
description: Select the days of the week on which orders are shipped.

name: Shipping Error: Amount
description: Enter a shipping error amount below.  In the event of an error calculating shipping, this charge will be displayed to the customer.

name: Shipping Error: Carrier Name
description: Enter a shipping error carrier name below.  In the event of an error calculating shipping, this carrier name will be displayed to the customer.

name: Default Country Selection
description: This is the default country selected for shipping estimates.

name: Default Residential/Commercial Selection
description: This is the default residential/commercial for shipping estimates.

name: Activate Shipping Estimates
description: This status indicator allows you to turn shipping estimates on (true) or off (false).

name: Express Shipping: Methods
value: 1 Day, Next Day, 2 Day, 2nd Day, 3 Day, 3rd Day, Overnight
description: Enter a single, or comma-delimited list, of partial shipping method names which, when matched, will note a shipment as an express shipment.

name: Express Shipping: Notice
description: Enter a notice to be displayed on order confirmations, and in the shipping method selection area in checkout when an express shipping method is selected.

name: Free Shipping: Threshold Trigger Status
description: Inventory items can be set up to automatically trigger the free shipping threshold if found in the order.  Set this setting to false (0) to disable this functionality for all items.  Select true (1) to allow items to trigger the free shipping threshold when present in the order.  The free shipping threshold will be triggered if the order total exceeds the threshold, regardless of the value of this setting.

name: Handling Charge
description: Enter a handling charge below.  If you enter an amount greater than zero, the handling charge specified will be added to the cost for each shipment.  Set to '0.00' to turn off.

name: Free Shipping: Add Handling Charge
description: Set this field to true to add handling charges to free shipping methods. Set this field to false to prevent handling charges from being added to free shipping methods.

name: Shipping Times: Shipping Holidays
description: Enter a comma delimited list of holidays on which items cannot be shipped. Dates should be entered in the format YYYY-MM-DD (ISO 8601). Separate all dates with a comma. Example: 2016-01-01, 2016-01-02

name: Local Pickup Option: Limit to Management Interface
description: You can limit the display of the local pickup option, if active, to the Management Interface only by setting this option to true (1).

name: Local Pickup Option: Display Option
description: Select true (1) to display a free local pickup option when item are being shipped from the local warehouse.  This setting activates the local pickup option for all customers.  To limit to a geographic area or to the manageemnt interface, adjust those local pickup settings.

name: Local Pickup Option: Limit Delivery Area
description: You can limit the display of the local pickup option, if active, to a delivery area.  This can be the same state/province or country as the local warehouse.

name: Local Pickup Option: Display Name
description: Enter a name to be displayed for the free local pickup option, if active.

name: Local Pickup Option: Extra Shipping Text
description: Enter text here to display an extra message about shipping in the shipping estimator and checkout when the local pickup option is selected.

name: Realtime: Minimum Box Height
description: Enter a minimum height for boxes to be shipped via realtime carriers.  If a box is presented to the shipping module with a height below this minimum, the minimum specified here will be used.

name: Realtime: Minimum Box Length
description: Enter a minimum length for boxes to be shipped via realtime carriers.  If a box is presented to the shipping module with a length below this minimum, the minimum specified here will be used.

name: Realtime: Minimum Box Weight
description: Enter a minimum weight for boxes to be shipped via realtime carriers.  If a box is presented to the shipping module with a weight below this minimum, the minimum specified here will be used.

name: Realtime: Minimum Box Width
description: Enter a minimum width for boxes to be shipped via realtime carriers.  If a box is presented to the shipping module with a width below this minimum, the minimum specified here will be used.

name: Free Shipping: Must Rate Status
description: Select true (1) to calculate minimum rates for Inventory Items which are marked as Must Rate, when free shipping is active.  Set to false (0) to disable and ignore Inventory Item Must Rate settings.

name: Realtime: Present Shipper Footer Display
description: Select true (1) to display shipper information on the footer of any pages where realtime rates are calculated.  This display is required by some realtime shipping carriers, like UPS.

name: Shipping Times: Ship Cutoff Time
description: Select the time at which orders must be received in order to ship the same day.  A selection of 12:00 AM will force orders to be shipped next day.

name: Category Displays: Highlight Special Offer Discount
description: Select true (1) to display and highlight the special offer discount percentage on category displays in the Special Offers section.

name: Display In Stock Info
description: Select true display in stock information for products.  Selecting false will only display out of stock products with an out of stock message.

name: Display In Stock Level
description: Display In Stock Info must be set to true for this setting to take effect.  Select true display the invetory level when displaying in stock information for products.  Selecting false will display only an in stock message for in stock products.

name: Enable Show Price In Cart Only
description: Select true (1) to enable Show Price In Cart Only functionality for Product Offers.  When enabled, items marked as Show Price In Cart Only will have pricing viewable only in the shopping cart.

name: Product Detail Pages: Highlight Special Offer Discount
description: Select true (1) to display and highlight the special offer discount percentage for Special Offer product offers.

name: Product Listing: Display Sort Options
description: Select true to display product sort options in standard view product listings to users who are browsing the online store.

name: Special Offers Active
description: Select true (1) to activate Special Offers, or false (0) to deactivate it.  If inactive, items marked as Special Offers will not be available in the online store.

name: Special Offers Display: Banner Advertisement Group
description: Enter a banner advertisement group name if you would like to display banner advertisements at the top of the Special Offers page. Leave blank to suppress banner advertisements. If a group name is entered, a banner advertisement placed in the content section must have this group name in order to display a banner advertisement.

name: Special Offers Limits: Cookie Value
description: When Special Offers are active, and limited to customers with a special cookie, this is the value used for the cookie issued to the customer.

name: Special Offers Info: Description
value: Get discounted pricing on Special Offer items when you buy today.
description: This description is used when displaying information about Special Offers.

name: Special Offers Limitations
description: When Special Offers are active, you can select to limit Special Offers to customers.  Select the limitations you would like to put into place for Special Offers.  Selecting no limitations will allow Special Offers for all shoppers.

name: Category Menu Display Status
description: Select true (1) to display Special Offers in the store category menu when active, or false (0) not show a menu item for Special Offers.

name: Special Offers Info: Name
description: This display name is used for all references to the Special Offers page.

name: Special Offers Article Display
description: If you have the Articles extension module installed, and it's active, enter an identifer for an article here to display abbreviated article content on the special offers mail page.  This article will appear below any category and product offer listings.

name: Disable Discount Code Usage
description: Select true (1) to diable discount code usage for Special Offers for 'Exclude Item(s)' discounts codes. If selected, items added to the cart using Special Offers are not discounted in checkout with 'Exclude Item(s)' type discount codes.  This field is used in addition to the 'Exclude Item(s)' product list entered for the discount code.

name: Special Offers Header
description: If you would like to display a header on the special offers main page, enter the header here. This header can contain XHTML tags.

name: Main Page: Parent Category Navigation
description: Select the type of category navigation to display on the special offers main page.  This feature is useful for changing the display type based on the size of the sale.

name: Main Page: Product Heading Text
value: Save Today On These Incredible Offers
description: This heading name is used above the product listing (when displayed) on the special offers main page.

name: Main Page: Display Product Offers
description: Select true to display product offers on the special offers main page.  This feature is useful for changing the display type based on the size of the sale.

name: Category Header: Display Type
description: Select the type for the category header when displayed on special offer pages.  You can select description only, image and descripiton, or to disable the display.

name: Special Offers Limits: User Groups
description: When Special Offers are active, and limited to certain user groups, this listing controls which groups are allowed access.

name: Banner Advertisement Group
description: Enter a banner advertisement group name if you would like to display banner advertisements in the display skin when the store splash page is viewed.

name: Bypass Store Splash Page
description: You can choose to change links printed to the store splash page so they target the default home page instead, and in doing so, bypass the store splash page.  Select true (1) to bypass the store splash page, and target the default home page for store home links.

name: Product List: Heading Name
description: If there are products to display on the store splash page, the name below is used to present a heading.

name: Product List: Activate Slider
description: If there are products to display on the store splash page, choose true (1) to activate a slider control for those products, or false (0) to suppress the slider.

name: Custom Surcharge Method
description: If you have selected to activate the Custom Surcharge Method Status, select the custom surcharge method to execute during checkout below.

name: Accounting System Log Entry Storage Time
description: Select the number of weeks to store accounting system log entries.

name: Shopping Cart/Wish List Storage Time
description: Select the number of months to unmodified store shopping carts and wish lists in the database.  Shopping carts and wish lists are modified each time a user adds, updates or removes an item in their shopping cart and/or wish list.

name: Order Storage Time - Pending/Cancelled
description: Select the number of days to store pending and cancelled orders.  Past orders with dates older than this value, and future orders with dates beyond this value, will be removed automatically each week.

name: UPS Account Number
description: Enter your UPS account number.  This number is required if you would like to receive negotiated rates.

name: UPS Address Verification: Activate
description: Select true (1) to activate UPS Address Verification of all US-based addresses.  Address verification is handled using UPS, and requires a UPS OnLine® Tools connection configured.  Select false (0) to disable this feature.

name: Activate Delivery Estimates
description: Select true (1) to display UPS delivery date estimates, based on time in transit (TiT), with rates.

name: Use UPS Negotiated Rates
description: Set this field to true to use negotiated rates from UPS. Set this field to false to use UPS counter rates.

name: UPS Branded Tracking Link ID
description: To activate branded tracking links for items shipped via UPS in order confirmations, enter your UPS Branded Tracking ID.

name: Custom Sale Method Status
description: Select true to activate a custom sale method during checkout.  If you select to activate a custom sale method during checkout, the Custom Sale Method specified on this page will be executed.

name: Custom Surcharge Method Status
description: Select true to activate a custom surcharge method during checkout.  If you select to activate a custom surcharge method during checkout, the Custom Surcharge Method specified on this page will be executed.

name: Use USPS Contract Rates
description: If you supplied an Enterprise Payment Account Number when configuring your USPS API connection, set this field to true to use contract rates from USPS. Set this field to false to use USPS retail rates.

name: Return Currency
description: Select the currency used by USPS to return shipping rates for your USPS account.

name: Order Processing: Create Customer Accounts
description: Select true (1) to create customer accounts for new customers who place orders on Amazon.  A mail message will be sent to the customer, altering them an account has been created.  Select false (0) to create guest orders for Amazon customers.

name: Import Controls: Default Fulfillment Latency
description: Select the default fulfillment latency for imported offers.  Note that fulfillment latency of two days or less are considered default latency times.

name: Import Controls: Default Fulfillment Type
description: Select the default fulfillment type for imported offers.  Note that your Amazon seller account must be FBA-Enabled to use Fulfillment by Amazon options.

name: Inventory Level Control: Maximum Offer Inventory
description: Enter the maximum inventory level to use for inventory.  This setting controls how many items are available and helps limit overall catalog value, which may have limits on total value in place.

name: Order Invoice Display Option
description: Select true (1) to display a printable order invoice link instead of a printable order summary link for completed Amazon orders.  Select false (0) to always display a printable order summary link.

name: Order Invoice Mail Option
description: Select the conditions under which Amazon orders will receive an order invoice mail message, instead of an order complete mail message, when the order is completed. This option is only valid when the Order Processing: Send Customer Mail Messages setting is set to true (1), and the Order Manager setting Send Order Completed Mail Messages is active.

name: Local Inventory Oversell: Disable
description: For the Amazon channel, select true (1) to disable Local Inventory Oversell, if it is activated.  Select false (0) to use global Inventory Oversell settings.

name: Inventory Level Control: Unlimited/Dropshipped
description: Enter the inventory level to use for inventory which has an unlimited supply, or is dropshipped by default or when out of local inventory.

name: Order Number Prefix
description: If you've selected a prefixed Order Number Type this prefix will be appended to all Amazon order numbers.

name: Channel Status: Orders Downloads and Updates
description: Select true (1) to download, process and update orders placed on Amazon.  Select false (0) to disable this function and process orders manually, or with another application.

name: Channel Status: FBA Tracking Info Import
description: Select true (1) to enable tracking information imports for orders which are shipped through Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA).  Select false (0) to disable this function and enter tracking information for FBA orders manually.  Orders Downloads and Updates must be active to utilize this functionality.

name: Shipping Carrier Name: Other
description: Enter a shipping carrier name to transmit to Amazon for orders which have tracking numbers entered for the 'Other' carrier.

name: Order Processing: Send Customer Mail Messages
description: Select true (1) to send mail messages to customers for orders downloaded from Amazon.  Mail messages sent for Amazon orders include order confirmation, partially shipped and complete messages.

name: Shipping Service Name: Expedited
description: Enter the shipping service name to use for Amazon orders which are shipped via the Expedited service level.

name: Shipping Service Name: Free Economy
description: Enter the shipping service name to use for Amazon orders which are shipped via the Free Economy service level.

name: Shipping Service Name: Next Day
description: Enter the shipping service name to use for Amazon orders which are shipped via the Next Day service level.

name: Shipping Service Name: Same Day
description: Enter the shipping service name to use for Amazon orders which are shipped via the Same Day service level.

name: Shipping Service Name: Scheduled
description: Enter the shipping service name to use for Amazon orders which are shipped via the Scheduled service level.

name: Shipping Service Name: Second Day
description: Enter the shipping service name to use for Amazon orders which are shipped via the Secondy Day service level.

name: Shipping Service Name: Standard
description: Enter the shipping service name to use for Amazon orders which are shipped via the Standard service level.

name: Channel Status: Inventory Updates
description: Select true (1) to update inventory for offers on Amazon when offers are automatically synchronized.  Select false (0) disable this function and manage Amazon inventory manually, or with another application.

name: High Profit Highlight Percentage
description: Enter a percentage, without a percent sign, which will trigger a high profit highlight (GREEN) in the customer viewer.

name: Low Profit Highlight Percentage
description: Enter a percentage, without a percent sign, which will trigger a low profit highlight (RED) in the customer viewer.

name: Marginal Profit Highlight Percentage
description: Enter a percentage, without a percent sign, which will trigger a marginal profit highlight (ORANGE) in the customer viewer.

name: Customer Viewer Extension Module Status
description: This status is set to indicate the Customer Viewer extension module is installed.

name: Order Processing: Create Customer Accounts
description: Select true (1) to create customer accounts for new customers who place orders on eBay.  A mail message will be sent to the customer, altering them an account has been created.  Select false (0) to create guest orders for eBay customers.

name: Use Description Template for Cloned Product Offers
description: Select true (1) to use a template to format offer descriptions for eBay when cloning a Store Catalog Product Offer as an eBay Offer.  Select false (0) to use the description as entered for the Store Catalog Product Offer.

name: Inventory Level Control: Maximum Offer Inventory
description: Enter the maximum inventory level to use for inventory.  This setting controls how many items are available and helps limit overall catalog value, which may have limits on total value in place.

name: Order Invoice Display Option
description: Select true (1) to display a printable order invoice link instead of a printable order summary link for completed eBay orders.  Select false (0) to always display a printable order summary link.

name: Order Invoice Mail Option
description: Select the conditions under which eBay orders will receive an order invoice mail message, instead of an order complete mail message, when the order is completed. This option is only valid when the Order Processing: Send Customer Mail Messages setting is set to true (1), and the Order Manager setting Send Order Completed Mail Messages is active.

name: Local Inventory Oversell: Disable
description: For the eBay channel, select true (1) to disable Local Inventory Oversell, if it is activated.  Select false (0) to use global Inventory Oversell settings.

name: Inventory Level Control: Unlimited/Dropshipped
description: Enter the inventory level to use for inventory which has an unlimited supply, or is dropshipped by default or when out of local inventory.

name: Order Number Prefix
description: If you've selected a prefixed Order Number Type this prefix will be appended to all eBay order numbers.

name: Channel Status: Orders Downloads and Updates
description: Select true (1) to download, process and update orders placed on eBay.  Select false (0) to disable this function and process orders manually, or with another application.

name: Activate PayPal Payments
description: If you accept PayPal payments for eBay orders, select true (1) here.  If you have this value set to false (0), but see warning '11012' when creating offers for eBay, your eBay account is configured to automatically accept PayPal payments, and you should set this value to true (1) to satisfy this warning.

name: PayPal Email Address
description: Enter the email address for the PayPal account used by your eBay account.  Offers created by this software will use this email address as the PayPal email address for the offer.

name: Order Processing: Send Customer Mail Messages
description: Select true (1) to send mail messages to customers for orders downloaded from eBay.  Mail messages sent for eBay orders include order confirmation, partially shipped and complete messages.

name: Seller Account User Token
description: This is your Seller Account User Token, as provided by eBay.  This token is automatically set up when you configure your eBay connection, and is available here to update, if your token changes or expires.

name: Channel Status: Inventory Updates
description: Select true (1) to update inventory for offers on eBay when offers are automatically synchronized.  Select false (0) disable this function and manage eBay inventory manually, or with another application.

name: Google Merchant ID
description: Enter your Google Merchant ID for your Google Merchant Account which is configured to use Google Customer Reviews.

name: Display Google Customer Reviews Badge
description: This status indicator allows you to turn the Google Customer Reviews badge on (true) or off (false).  Leave this setting off until such time as Google has informed you reviews are available and your badge is ready.

name: Activate Google Customer Reviews
description: This status indicator allows you to turn the Google Customer Reviews on (true) or off (false).  If set to on, this module will prompt customers to complete Google Reviews for purchases.  You must have a Google Merchant Account with Google Customer Reviews active to use this module.

name: Default Shipping Time in Transit
description: Enter a default number of days to be used for a default time in transit for shipments.  Time in transit is used to calculate  expected delivery dates for orders when submitting to Google Customer Reviews.  If Delivery Estimates are active for the order, the delivery estimate will be used instead.
